description: A TEAM FROM GHANA AND PASSIONATE ABOUT HOW TO MAKE RELEVANT USE OF NASA DATA
summary:
Astro is Team Tidy’s approach to addressing the health challenges astronauts face during extended space exploration. Since medical support is not always immediately accessible in deep space, having a reliable way to monitor astronauts’ health is essential. Our platform provides a centralized space where astronauts can record and monitor important health indicators, including heart rate, body temperature, and hydration.
Through an interactive dashboard, users can easily view their health information and identify changes that may require attention. Astro also incorporates an AI-powered assistant to provide accessible health-related guidance, while its alert system highlights unusual readings and keeps both astronauts and medical teams on Earth informed. Although health information is currently entered manually, future development will explore integration with wearable technology. Ultimately, Astro aims to make health monitoring more accessible, improve communication between astronauts and ground-based medical teams, and contribute to safer long-duration space missions.
details:
Imagine being hundreds of kilometers above Earth, and something feels off. Your heart seems faster than usual, or you've barely had any water today. There's no clinic down the hall and no doctor to call. That is the problem Astro was built to solve.
Astro is a health monitoring platform created by Team Tidy. Just as mission control watches over a spacecraft, Astro watches over the people inside it. Astronauts log their daily heart rate, body temperature, and hydration, and the information is displayed on a centralized dashboard where users can easily review their records. Instead of guessing how they feel, astronauts can see how their health is changing day by day.
When something doesn't look right, Astro responds. Its alert system notifies both the astronaut and the medical team on Earth the moment an unusual reading appears. Its built-in AI assistant answers health questions on the spot, so help is always within reach, even when Earth is not.
Our goal is to contribute to safer and healthier space exploration by improving how astronauts monitor and manage their health. Astro aims to encourage early awareness of potential health concerns, support communication with medical professionals, and make health information easier to manage during long-duration missions where immediate medical assistance may be limited.
Astro was developed using TypeScript, React, CSS, JavaScript, and Python. React and TypeScript were used in building the application, while CSS and JavaScript supported the interface design and interactive functionality. Python was also used as part of the development process.
During development, our team considered the unique difficulties of maintaining good health in space. These included limited access to immediate medical assistance, the physical demands of long-duration missions, the importance of monitoring changes in health measurements, and the need for clear communication between astronauts and medical teams on Earth. We also considered ease of use, accessibility, and the possibility of expanding the platform through wearable technology in the future.
